verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents an official Figma Make SDK for programmatic access. A community report says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, so users had to reverse-engineer the format, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Syncing npm packages and connecting MCP tools are inputs to generation, not SDKs for building against Make, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
